source.author: ov
source.text: Talia diversa nequiquam sede locuti sub noctem dixere vale partique dedere oscula quisque suae non pervenientia contra.
source.text_original: Talia diversa nequiquam sede locuti / sub noctem dixere 'vale' partique dedere / oscula quisque suae non pervenientia contra.
source.text_english: After speaking such things in vain from their separate places, at nightfall they said farewell and each gave kisses to his own beloved, kisses that did not reach across to the other.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illis Taenario pariter tremit ignea fuco purpura, quod gemina mater spectabile tela duxit opus; bis Taygeton silvasque comantes struxerat, Eurotan molli bis fuderat auro; quemque suus sonipes niveo de stamine portat et volat amborum patrius de pectore cycnus.
reuse.text_original: illis Taenario pariter tremit ignea fuco / purpura, quod gemina mater spectabile tela / duxit opus; bis Taygeton silvasque comantes / struxerat, Eurotan molli bis fuderat auro; / quemque suus sonipes niveo de stamine portat / et volat amborum patrius de pectore cycnus.
reuse.text_english: For them the fiery purple on Taenarian dye trembles likewise, because the mother drew together the splendid work with twin threads; twice had she woven Taygetus and its leafy forests, twice had she poured Eurotas with soft gold; and each horse carries its rider from snowy warp, and the native swan flies from the breast of both.
